views.markdown:
**zathura** is a highly customizable, keyboard-driven document viewer for Xios.

Built on GTK3 and the girara interface library, it opens PDF files through the bundled poppler plugin and drives them entirely from the keyboard.

- Keyboard-first navigation in the vi tradition
- PDF rendering through the poppler plugin
- Search, links, bookmarks, and a fit-to-page view
- Light and dark recoloring for comfortable reading

Install `zathura-pdf-poppler` for PDF support, which this repo also ships.

[More screenshots and port details](https://xios.maxleiter.com/apps/zathura)
